citations.quote: Problems with Libor first arose during the 2007–2009 global financial crisis, when the perceived default and liquidity risks of major international banks rose significantly.
Commonly proposed explanations for the corresponding spreads refer to a combined effect of credit risk and liquidity risk.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Liquidity dimensions of cash-bond markets: bid-ask, dealer inventory, on-the-run / off-the-run benchmarks, and repo specialness as the liquidity-premium machinery for credit spreads.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Cash-Bond Liquidity
